Teaser posters reveal only partial bodywork and side profiles, keeping the full exterior designs under wraps.
The first model, built for new-generation urban users, features 20-inch sport alloy wheels, a 15.6-inch central touchscreen and an 8.8-inch digital instrument cluster.
Equipped with 800V high-voltage fast charging, it recharges to 50% in just 18 minutes and delivers a WLTP range of over 500 km, balancing daily commuting efficiency with driving refinement.
With 6/7/8-seat configurations, it offers 512 L of luggage space at full occupancy and 37 storage compartments.

items.title: Opinion: can the Jaguar Type 01 save the brand?
items.summary: The Type 01 has at last been revealed – and the market has changed hugely since it was first conceived Finally, the new Jaguar is here . Rarely has a car's arrival been so drawn out, as well as so storied. You can't imagine an Audi Q5 having this start to its existence... But then the Type 01 isn't just a new car. It's also a completely new start for its maker. Neither the Type 01 nor the brand be
facts: The Type 01 has at last been revealed – and the market has changed hugely since it was first conceived Finally, the new Jaguar is here .
You can't imagine an Audi Q5 having this start to its existence...
But then the Type 01 isn't just a new car.
Neither the Type 01 nor the brand behind it has any link to the modern Jaguar that the market has come to know.
Amid the relief that the Type 01 has finally arrived, we mustn't forget the risks still inherent in this relaunch.
For example, going all-electric was in tune with the market at the start of the 2020s but still only Tesla exists as a successful electric-only car company.

items.title: Jaguar’s new Type 01 EV looks like a comic book villain would drive it
items.summary: Jaguar has unveiled the final version of its new Type 01 EV, the first car as part of its controversial rebrand, and it’s a 1,016 horsepower, four-door, 1930s-comic-book-mobster-style doozy. more…
facts: Jaguar has unveiled the final version of its new Type 01 EV, the first car as part of its controversial rebrand, and it’s a 1,016 horsepower, four-door, 1930s-comic-book-mobster-style doozy.

Jaguar made waves in late 2024 when it revealed a new concept car (the Type 00) and a controversial rebranding, changing its wordmark and design language to be radically different from anything we’ve seen from the legendary marque before – or indeed, perhaps any automotive company.
(Personally, I loved it, and perhaps loved it even more for each pearl that was clutched in response).

items.title: Jaguar Heard The Rebrand Haters. It Doesn't Think They're Its Customers
items.summary: Jaguar doesn't need everyone to like it's new direction, top boss Rawdon Glover told us.
facts: - Jaguar's 2024 brand relaunch attracted deep criticism, but it insists that the critics aren't the brand's target buyers.
- The Type 01 goes on sale in early 2027, starting at $130,500.

In November 2024, our social media feeds were inundated with young, multicultural models in wacky outfits, strutting silently yet confidently through a high-contrast background that wouldn’t look out of place in a Wes Anderson film.
Jaguar Type 00 Concept
Nearly two years later, looking at the production Type 01 at Jaguar’s office in Gaydon, England, I wanted to know: Did any of it really matter?

items.title: Jaguar Says America Is The Most Important Market For Its New Electric Sedan
items.summary: Despite the $130,000 price tag, Jaguar says that the U.S. and Canada are its most important markets for the Type 01 sedan.
facts: Despite the $130,000 price tag, Jaguar says that the U.S.

Love it or hate it, the Type 01 is a very striking vehicle; with its almost cartoonish cab-rearward proportions and designo-luxe-minimalist interior, the car looks strikingly different from any Jaguar ever made.
During my time at JLR’s facilities in Gaydon, England, Jaguar explained part of its sales plans and target markets for the Type 01.

items.title: The Jaguar Type 01 Won't Be The Only Model To Look Like This
items.summary: The brand wants the Type 01 four-door GT to take the limelight, but more models are coming soon.
facts: The Jaguar Type 01 Won't Be The Only Model To Look Like This
The brand wants the Type 01 four-door GT to take the limelight, but more models are coming soon.
- Jaguar didn't say when, but the Type 01 will be followed by another model, likely an SUV or crossover.
- For now, Jaguar says it wants the Type 01 to take up the spotlight.
Love it or hate it, the Jaguar Type 01 definitely stands out; the four-door GT (don’t call it a sedan; JLR executives corrected me when I did) is such a striking-looking car.
But with an expected price tag in the six figures, I can’t imagine the Type 01 ever being a strong volume seller.

items.title: The Jaguar Type 01 Is A 1,000-horsepower Beast. But It Isn’t For Everyone
items.summary: It looks oh-so-cool, but it’s not cheap or practical, and will likely ruffle a few feathers.
facts: The Jaguar Type 01 Is A 1,000-horsepower Beast.
- The Jaguar Type 01 is the production version of the Type 00 coupe.
- Jaguar calls the Type 01 a four-door GT, not a sedan.
- The Type 01 will open for sale early next year, and start at a price of $130,500.
“We don’t anticipate this car being for everyone,” Rawdon Glover, the Managing Director of Jaguar, said at the unveiling of the Jaguar Type 01.
Thankfully, the haters haven’t prevailed, because the Jaguar Type 01 is such a stunning piece of metal.
Jaguar’s tagline for both the brand and the car is “Copy Nothing,” and I have to agree—the Type 01 doesn’t look like much else on the road.

items.title: New Jaguar Type 01: radical EV arrives to spearhead brand's reboot
items.summary: Bold 1000bhp £150,000 grand tourer will kick-start British brand’s EV-only rebirth Jaguar has revealed the Type 01, the electric GT on which the brand's future rests. Five years ago Jaguar, unprofitable for years, found itself in a life-threatening quandary. The political situation surrounding large petrol and diesel cars was changing fast, propelled by onrushing EV technology. The company was als
facts: Bold 1000bhp £150,000 grand tourer will kick-start British brand’s EV-only rebirth Jaguar has revealed the Type 01, the electric GT on which the brand's future rests.

Something had to be done, and there were three options: close Jaguar and lose vast sums for no gain; make cost-cutting tweaks to the existing cars and hope for better times; or produce a range of cars to relive the shock and desire of the E-Type 65 years ago.
Choosing the third option, at a cost of about £2.25 billion, has produced the Type 01.

items.title: Fiat 500 Hybrid test: Cute looks and a nice interior – but terribly slow
items.summary: Fiat performs the unprecedented and converts an EV to petrol power. Is it any good? The very existence of the new Fiat 500 Hybrid is tantamount to the Italian giant breaking the emergency glass.Having finally discontinued the petrol 500 in August 2024, it had expected the new-shape, electric 500e to pick up the mantle. What happened instead was an utter collapse in sales, as buyers defected to pet
facts: The conversion required the near-total redevelopment of the 500e: new subframes are located at the front and rear ends to accommodate a petrol engine and six-speed manual gearbox, and a fuel tank has been subbed in for the EV’s traction battery.
Even with the 500e’s diminutive motor removed, space under the bonnet was severely limited.
The 1.2-litre Puretech petrol engine deployed in a range of Stellantis models, including the larger Fiat Grande Panda, simply wouldn’t have fit.
That left the naturally aspirated 1.0-litre three-cylinder used by the previous 500 Hybrid and updated for the Italian-market Panda in 2024 as the only option.

items.title: The Tesla Model 3 And Model Y Can Now Power Your Home In A Blackout
items.summary: Before this, Tesla's Powershare feature was only available on the Cybertruck.
facts: The Tesla Model 3 And Model Y Can Now Power Your Home In A Blackout
- The Tesla Model 3 and Model Y just got one of the best features electric cars offer.
The Tesla Model 3 and Model Y can now help back up your home in a blackout, the company announced Tuesday.
Before, Tesla's only model with vehicle-to-home (V2H) capability was the Cybertruck.
Now the Model 3 and Model Y join a growing list of EVs that can use their big battery packs as, essentially, emergency generators.
Those include lots of Chevy and Cadillac EVs, plus the Kia EV9 and Nissan Leaf.

facts: This confidence is backed by an ambitious plan to increase total production by 1.3 million by 2030 – a number that requires Hyundai to launch or facelift 100 models by 2030.
Go big or go home, as they say.A total of 41 of those new releases will be landing on European shores, and the latest is the Hyundai Ioniq 3.

An entry-level addition to Hyundai’s burgeoning electric sub-brand, this B-segment hatchback is also arguably one of its most important arrivals to date.Packing a decent range, especially in bigger-battery guise, distinctive looks and a claimed focus on driver satisfaction, the Ioniq 3 is charged with capturing a new generation of EV customers.Then there’s the pricing.

items.title: US gas plant plans jump 44% in just 8 months – here’s why
items.summary: The US is planning a lot more gas power – and data centers are the culprit. Proposed grid-connected gas capacity has nearly tripled since early 2023, while plans for new wind power are shrinking. more…
facts: Proposed grid-connected gas capacity has nearly tripled since early 2023, while plans for new wind power are shrinking.
A new analysis and interactive map from Environment America Research & Policy Center and Frontier Group puts the planned gas buildout at 60.4 gigawatts (GW) through the end of 2030.
That’s up 44% from the 41.8 GW expected in December 2025, based on filings submitted to the federal Energy Information Administration (EIA).
For perspective, that proposed new gas capacity alone exceeds the total generating capacity of every individual US state except Texas, California, and Florida, according to the groups.

items.title: This electric minivan is bringing an ’80s icon back to life
items.summary: The E-Space Concept is an all-electric reboot of Renault’s iconic minivan from the 1980’s. more…
facts: The E-Space Concept is an all-electric reboot of Renault’s iconic minivan from the 1980’s.
With the futuristic E-Space Concept, Renault said it’s “rebooting the spirit” of the original Espace that launched in 1984.
While Renault already sells the Espace as an SUV, this one will be closer to the iconic MPV from the ’80s.
Measuring 4,700 mm long, Renault’s electric minivan is about the same size as the Kia PV5 and Volkswagen ID.
The square running lights look nearly identical to the Renault 5.
According to Auto Express, the minivan will use Renault’s new RGEV Medium 2.0 platform, which could deliver a driving range of around 500 miles.

items.title: Toyota shuts down rumors claiming that it’s ‘slashing prices’ in China
items.summary: Toyota’s joint venture, FAW Toyota, issued a statement denying reports that it’s “slashing prices” in China and may exit the market entirely. more…
facts: The long-standing joint ventures produce and sell Toyota models, including the Corolla, RAV4, and Avalon, as well as new electric vehicles like the bZ3 and bZ5.
Last week, on September 28, GAC Group announced plans to acquire a 50% stake in FAW Toyota.
The plans include issuing new A-shares priced at 5.75 yuan per share.
FAW Toyota was established in 2000 as a joint venture between FAW Group and Toyota, with each holding a 50% share.
It was initially called Tianjin FAW Toyota Motor Co until 2003, when it adopted the name FAW Toyota.
Once the agreement is finalized, GAC Group would take FAW’s 50% stake, while Toyota would retain the other 50%.

2027 Mitsubishi Eclipse Sportback EV prices and range
Mitsubishi is taking another crack at the US EV market, nearly a decade after it stopped selling the i-MiEV in 2017.
The new 2027 Eclipse Sportback EV will go on sale this month priced from $37,745, Mitsubishi said on Tuesday.
With the $1,995 destination fee, prices come to $39,740.

items.title: Tesla Model 3 and Model Y can finally power your home
items.summary: Tesla has turned on Powershare Home Backup for the Model 3 and Model Y, which means its two volume cars can now send power back into a house during an outage. Until today, the Cybertruck was the only Tesla that could do it. There are limits. You need a Powerwall 3, and Tesla only guarantees the feature on cars ordered since October 1. For years, Ford and GM have been selling EVs that can back up a
facts: Tesla has turned on Powershare Home Backup for the Model 3 and Model Y, which means its two volume cars can now send power back into a house during an outage.
You need a Powerwall 3, and Tesla only guarantees the feature on cars ordered since October 1.
Tesla’s updated Powershare page says the feature is “currently available for all Cybertruck vehicles, and all new Model 3 and Model Y vehicles ordered on October 1, 2026 or later.”
You plug the car into a Wall Connector or Universal Wall Connector at a home that has a Powerwall 3.
Tesla says a Model 3 or Model Y adds “over two days” of backup for a home that uses 30 kWh a day, starting from a 90% charge.

items.title: Waymo to launch operations in Singapore in 2028
items.summary: Following its expansion into Germany and Japan in 2027, Waymo plans to enter Singapore in 2028. This will be the Alphabet-owned autonomous, all-electric ride-hailing service provider's first market in Southeast Asia.
facts: Waymo to launch operations in Singapore in 2028
The company plans to commence testing its autonomous fleet in Singapore in 2027.

It aims to start offering fully autonomous trips to the public through the Waymo app the following year and has set up a dedicated page on its website to keep potential customers updated on its progress.
Autonomous vehicles have covered more than 160,000 km during testing on fixed routes in Singapore without a major accident, he added.
In the context of Waymo’s announcement, Siow said that currently there are 16 passenger vehicles, all operating in Punggol.

items.title: Geodis orders 110 battery-electric trucks from Renault and Volvo
items.summary: Geodis has ordered 110 heavy-duty electric trucks for its European road transport operations. The 44-tonne vehicles from Renault Trucks and Volvo Trucks are to be delivered by May 2027 and will primarily operate in France on urban and long-haul routes.
facts: Geodis orders 110 battery-electric trucks from Renault and Volvo
The company has placed a firm order for 110 battery-electric 44-tonne trucks with Renault Trucks and Volvo Trucks.
The vehicles are scheduled for delivery by May 2027.
With this order, the electric truck fleet of the European Road Network business unit is set to grow to a total of 190 vehicles.
GEODIS has not yet disclosed how the 110 vehicles are divided between Renault Trucks and Volvo Trucks, nor which specific models have been ordered.
Along key French transport axes, so-called electric corridors are to be created, offering charging options at intervals of 250 to 500 km.

items.title: Mini Countryman gains rugged new Untamed trim
items.summary: Raised ride height, all-terrain tyres and host of new accessories produce brand's most off-road-ready SUV yet Mini has unveiled the new Countryman Untamed Edition, its most rugged, off-road-ready SUV yet. facts: A 15mm suspension lift combines with specially developed Pirelli Scorpion All Terrain Plus tyres to raise the ride height by up to 19mm, “significantly enhancing” off-road capability, according to Mini.

While the off-road tyres are standard in the US, they’re a £600 option in the UK, though every Untamed Edition gets a new 19in, five-spoke lightweight alloy design that mimics the tough steel wheels traditionally fitted to trail-ready 4x4s.
Untamed Editions are marked out by a new, vertically slatted front grille, a reshaped rear diffuser and a host of matt black body decals designed to protect the metalwork from stone chips.

items.title: Maritime Transport adds five Renault electric trucks to its fleet
items.summary: UK logistics company Maritime Transport has further expanded its eHGV fleet, with the addition of five Renault Trucks E-Tech T 4x2 electric tractor units. The trucks are being introduced through the eFREIGHT 2030 project and brings Maritime's total electric fleet up to 56 vehicles.

items.title: Akia Automotive to build 50 electric buses for Istanbul
items.summary: Turkish bus manufacturer Akia Automotive will build 50 electric buses for use in Istanbul. The local manufacturer has won the corresponding tender and plans to deliver them next year.
facts: Akia Automotive to build 50 electric buses for Istanbul
In an email statement, the company – founded in 2013 and headquartered in Istanbul – emphasised that this order marks “the first major tender for electric buses in Turkey”.
Beginning in 2027, Akia will manufacture 50 units of its Ultra LF12EV battery-electric solo bus for Istanbul.
The Akia Ultra LF12EV is a low-floor city bus equipped with a 240-kW electric motor and a 465 kWh battery.
According to the manufacturer, the vehicle can carry up to 80 passengers.
Thanks to a wheelchair ramp, the Ultra LF12EV is also accessible for passengers with limited mobility.

facts: The e SKY, Suzuki’s first electric kei car, is expected to undercut BYD’s Racco as Japan’s cheapest mini EV, starting at around $13,500.
Suzuki is entering Japan’s competitive electric mini car segment with the e SKY set to launch on November 16.
The e SKY will start at around 2.12 million yen, or about $13,500, according to Nikkei, making it the lowest-priced EV in its class.
BYD currently holds the title with the Racco EV priced from 2.145 million yen ($13,600).
Suzuki said the e SKY offers a WLTC driving range of up to 310 km (192 miles) and a “class-leading” AC energy consumption rating of 97 Wh/km.

items.title: KGM Torres EVX now eligible for UK Electric Car Grant
items.summary: Two BEVs from KGM (formerly SsangYong) are now eligible for UK government purchase grants. The Torres EVX eSUV qualifies for the £1,500 Electric Car Grant, joining the Musso EV which already qualified for the £5,000 Plug-in Van Grant.
facts: The Torres EVX now qualifies for the Band 2 grant, which is available for electric cars priced below £37,000.
This reduces the car’s starting price to £35,495, down from £36,995.
The Torres EVX is powered by a 73.4 kWh LFP battery supplied by BYD and features a WLTP range of up to 287 miles (462km).
Its single front-mounted electric motor produces 152 kW and 399 Nm of torque, with KGM quoting a 10-80 per cent DC charging time of 28 minutes at maximum 120 kW capacity.
In the UK, the EVX is available in two trim levels, with the higher-spec K40 priced from £39,295 before the ECG is applied.

items.title: Tesla sold under 1,000 cars in its first year in India, but it’s ramping
items.summary: Tesla has registered just 993 vehicles in India since it started deliveries there in September 2025, according to registration data compiled by Indian EV publication ElecTree . But 294 of those came in September 2026 alone. That’s a record month for Tesla in India, and it comes right after the automaker cut prices and launched the six-seat Model Y L. more…
facts: Tesla has registered just 993 vehicles in India since it started deliveries there in September 2025, according to registration data compiled by Indian EV publication ElecTree.
But 294 of those came in September 2026 alone.
Tesla needed nine months to sell 428 cars
Tesla launched in India in July 2025 with a Model Y priced at roughly $70,000, almost twice what it cost in the US at the time.
Tesla registered 69 cars in September 2025, its first month of deliveries, and it didn’t beat that figure for the next eight months.
It finished 2025 with 226 registrations and added only 202 more between January and May 2026, per ElecTree’s count.
February was the low point at 29 cars.

facts: The Kia EV3 starts at $29,890 in the US, and after a day of driving it around Vancouver Island, I think it’s the best-packaged affordable EV you can buy right now.
It comes with up to 321 miles of range, two battery sizes, and available all-wheel drive, which is more choice than anything else at this price.

Kia brought me to Vancouver Island last week to test the EV3 as it launches in North America.
The EV3 has been on sale overseas since 2024, and it quickly became one of the most popular EVs in Europe and won the 2025 World Car of the Year award before Kia finally decided to bring it here.

items.title: This funky solar electric scooter could handle your commute without ever plugging in
items.summary: There are plenty of ways to build a small electric vehicle. These days, the prevailing options have been to make it faster, give it more power, slap on bigger tires, or keep adding features until your humble little scooter has somehow turned into a 150-pound electric motorcycle. Or you can be brave and go in the other direction to ask a simpler question: How much vehicle do people actually need fo
facts: These days, the prevailing options have been to make it faster, give it more power, slap on bigger tires, or keep adding features until your humble little scooter has somehow turned into a 150-pound electric motorcycle.
Or you can be brave and go in the other direction to ask a simpler question: How much vehicle do people actually need for all those short trips around town?

The two-seat electric scooter tops out at just under 20 mph (32 km/h), carries a surprisingly large amount of cargo, and covers both sides of its body in solar panels capable of adding up to 18 miles (29 km) of range per day.

items.title: Arla Foods expands e-truck fleet with four DAF XD Electrics
items.summary: Arla Foods has added four additional battery-electric DAF XD Electric trucks to its electric fleet. The 6x2 trucks will deliver chilled dairy products in Denmark and will utilise a new charging facility located at the company's Hobro depot.
facts: The new vehicles are 6×2 rigid trucks with a power output of 350 kW and a 525-kWh battery.
DAF specifies a range of up to 550 km.
The trucks will be used to deliver chilled dairy products in Denmark.
For heavy distribution tasks, the manufacturer offers various 6×2 configurations.
The variant used by Arla features the largest available battery capacity at 525 kWh and utilises the maximum motor power of 350 kW from DAF’s electric drivetrain.
In parallel, Arla is also putting seven additional DAF XD trucks with 6×2 chassis and MX-11 diesel engines into operation.
These deliver 330 kW.
PACCAR Power Solutions is installing a charging system with a total capacity of 480 kW.

The RSJ46-33XDH/62 model will operate at the Rotterdam Shortsea Terminals (RST), Europe’s largest specialty port for short-sea shipping.

Hyster also emphasises a uniform software architecture across its products to enable consistent operation, diagnostics, and maintenance.

items.title: Bold new Renault E-Space Concept previews future electric MPV
items.summary: "Future-focused vision of the 1980s original" looks to make spacious monobox family cars fashionable again The new Renault E-Space Concept, set to be revealed in full at next week’s Paris motor show , previews a new electric version of the game-changing MPV. facts: The bold concept is intended to channel the spirit of the 1984 original, which helped spearhead the popularity of MPV models in the pre-SUV age.

Few details of the E-Space Concept – and no interior pictures – have been revealed ahead of its official unveiling at Paris, but Renault said it's 4700mm long and reflects “a new approach to the design of family cars”.
While SUVs remain dominant in global sales charts, there has been a resurgence in MPVs as firms electrify their line-ups, skateboard-style EV chassis being well-suited to spacious family vehicles.
Featuring a 0.7sqm glass roof that filter out 99.9% of UV rays, it's claimed to increase the sense of space in the car for passengers.

items.title: Polestar 5 road test: Great but too late
items.summary: Swedes deliver on six-year-old promise to take on the Porsche Taycan The mainly British-engineered Polestar 5 brings with it a tangible sense of fulfilment that has been rather a long time coming.This five-metre-long electric pseudo-saloon will serve almost like a punctuation mark at the end of what we may look back on, in years to come, as the first era in the history of this still-emerging and m
facts: If there is a happy compromise between actual ease of use and the ideological removal of ‘superfluous’ physical controls, Polestar passed it several years ago – and now needs to retrace its steps.

Other secondary controls should be illuminated and clearly marked, so you that don’t have to cover them with a finger (like the ones on the 5’s steering-wheel spokes), then look at a screen elsewhere before you’ve confidently identified the function of what you’re preparing to press.
A car’s central infotainment screen should, in our view, also have fewer responsibilities to juggle than the 14.5in, portrait-orientated one here.

A teaser image showcases its narrow headlight, illuminated
facts: Alpine will reveal the new Projet Spécial 1 – or PS1 – at next week’s Paris motor show.
It said the PS1 codename reflects that the concept sits outside its “everyday” cars – the A290 and A390 – as well as its flagship, the A110.
This is distinct from the next-generation A110, whose design has been hinted at in the form of a sculpture that will also be displayed in Paris.

It's possible that the PS1 will hint at the look of Alpine's forthcoming rival for the Ferrari SF90, which is due in 2028 with a turbo V6 hybrid powertrain that will combine for an output north of 1000bhp.
Equally it could hint at the long-mooted successor to the A310, a four-seat GT that was built between 1971 and 1984.

items.title: Not sold on Tesla Powerwall? There are great battery alternatives out there [update]
items.summary: Between increasingly extreme weather , rising electricity demands, and the rapid expansion of data centers, energy independence is starting to look less like a talking point for doomsday preppers and more like sound planning. That shift in thinking is driving more homeowners than ever towards solar-plus-battery energy solutions like the industry-leading Tesla Powerwall – but Powerwall isn’t the on
facts: UPDATE 05OCT26: added the EcoFlow DELTA Pro.
In the end, I went with the same solution I’ve been using on my 0% EV financing lists: alphabetical order, by brand.
Anker SOLIX X1
The Anker SOLIX X1 is built to be highly modular.
Starting out with a relatively modest 5 kWh of energy storage from a single low-profile LiFePO4 battery, the X1 system allows owners to stack storage and scale up all the way up to 180 kWh.
With Anker SOLIX X1, they can meet their most critical needs on day one, and build up to a system that can support their wants later.

items.title: Six Flags has installed one of the largest solar carports in the US
items.summary: Six Flags Magic Mountain is putting its parking lots to work with a new 12.37-megawatt (MW) solar installation – California’s largest solar carport. It’s expected to generate enough electricity each year to offset the annual power use of both the amusement park and neighboring Hurricane Harbor Los Angeles. more…
facts: Six Flags Magic Mountain is putting its parking lots to work with a new 12.37-megawatt (MW) solar installation – California’s largest solar carport.
Developed with the solar panel company Solar Optimum, the project installs 22,908 RECOM bifacial solar panels across 36 carport structures.
The canopies span roughly 637,000 square feet and shade about 4,315 parking spaces – 3,544 for guests and 771 for employees.
There’s also EV charging: Six Flags says the installation includes 109 charging connectors across the guest and employee lots.
A 2 MW/8 MWh battery system stores electricity for later use.
At its rated 2 MW output, 8 MWh works out to about four hours of discharge.

facts: Lucid (LCID) delivered 3,806 vehicles in the third quarter, down 7% from a year ago.

New CEO Silvio Napoli is selling down the unsold cars Lucid piled up in the first half of the year, and Q3 is the first quarter of 2026 in which it delivered more vehicles than it built.
Lucid Q3 deliveries and production
Lucid released its Q3 numbers today, a month ahead of its earnings report on November 9.

Production fell much harder, from 4,774 vehicles in Q2 to 2,954.

items.title: Gas cars fall below 50% of global new car sales for the first time
items.summary: Gas cars are now a minority of the world’s new car sales. Gasoline-only vehicles made up 49% of global new-vehicle sales in the first half of 2026, down from 73% in 2021, according to Mobility Global data first reported by Nikkei. It’s the first time on record that they’ve been under half. But there’s a catch: most of the cars taking their place still have a gas tank. more…
facts: Gasoline-only vehicles made up 49% of global new-vehicle sales in the first half of 2026, down from 73% in 2021, according to Mobility Global data first reported by Nikkei.
Gas cars lost 24 points of share in under five years
Nikkei reported its first-half numbers last week, and they show sales of gasoline-only cars down 10% from a year ago to 20.25 million units between January and June.
Their share fell three points in a single year, from 52% to 49%.
Battery-electric vehicles grew 12% to 6.87 million units and took 17% of the market, up three points.
Conventional hybrids grew 10% to 7.27 million units, or 18%.

facts: The LiveWire S4 Honcho Street has now met the Motorcycle Safety Foundation’s (MSF) criteria for use in rider training programs, opening the door for new riders to learn the ropes – and potentially earn their motorcycle endorsement – without first learning how to operate a clutch and gearbox on a gas-powered motorcycle.

items.title: Abarth 600e Competizione: 5 things you need to know about the most powerful Abarth ever
items.summary: The most potent Abarth in history shows electrification needn’t be the death of fun Even at an early age, Carlo Abarth was already a winner in the making. Legend has it that at just 11 years old, he wrapped leather belts around the wooden wheels of his scooter so he could go faster and beat the older kids in his neighbourhood. That insatiable need for speed and innate competitive spirit would go o
facts: Legend has it that at just 11 years old, he wrapped leather belts around the wooden wheels of his scooter so he could go faster and beat the older kids in his neighbourhood.
One of the more unusual being his victory over the Orient Express in an 850-mile race from Vienna to Ostend.
But Carlo’s legacy-defining moment came in 1949, when he founded Italy’s most famous tuning house: Abarth.
Starting out by fettling Fiats to make them go better, Abarth soon grew into an all-out performance powerhouse, creating some of the most iconic and celebrated sports cars of the past 70 years.
It’s called the Abarth 600e Competizione, and it’s the most powerful road car the Italian firm has ever created.

facts: While Evans entered the final round with a lead of 17 points over Pajari and 21 over Solberg, he also faced the toughest task opening the road and finished Friday in sixth overall.

While Solberg managed to get back on the road and still secure the rally victory, he finished the stage 8.9s down on Evans.

items.title: Hasta la vista, baby – Figure F.02 humanoid robots decommissioned, T2-style
items.summary: Decommissioning humanoid robots that are packed with proprietary tech is a tricky thing – you want to make sure none of the expensive raw material goes to waste, but you also need to make sure no one else gets a hold of your tech. The solution? Have your robots hurl themselves into a vat of molten steel, Terminator 2-style. more…
facts: Have your robots hurl themselves into a vat of molten steel, Terminator 2-style.
Figure had its second-generation F.02 robots march into a vat of molten steel – and the idea came from Mr.
T-800, himself.
Once at the foundry, three massive graphite electrodes powering a 75-ton electric arc furnace designed to melt solid steel scrap got to work.
Despite the extreme heat and intense electromagnetic fields, the Figure F.02 robots ran their AI programs seamlessly, even as camera equipment and other electronics failed in this environment.
“After the F.02 melt in Finland, we sent the resulting metal bars back to the US with a new purpose,” reads the copy.

items.title: Musk explains why Tesla Robotaxi is not running at night, and lidar is the answer
items.summary: Elon Musk says the main thing holding back Tesla Robotaxi’s night hours is that the cars have a hard time seeing pets in the dark. His example was “grey kittens on grey tarmac.” That’s a low-light, low-contrast detection problem, which is the textbook weakness of cameras and the exact thing lidar and radar handle. Musk has spent years calling those sensors a “crutch” and a “fool’s errand.” more…
facts: Late Friday night, Tesla’s Robotaxi account announced that the Austin service is “now available until 11pm.” Until now, it shut down at 10 PM.
When Tesla launched Robotaxi in Austin in June 2025, the app took ride requests from 6 AM to midnight.
It fires its own laser pulses and times how long they take to come back, which gives the car a distance and a 3D shape for whatever is sitting on the road.
It needs the kitten to stick up from the road, and kittens, being 3D objects, tend to do that.
It’s weaker on something that small, but it keeps working in the fog, dust and glare that blind cameras.
Waymo’s sixth-generation system has 13 cameras, 4 lidars and 6 radars.

facts: This weekend's Rally Sardinia marks the end of the line for Rally1 – and that's a great shame For the last four years, the World Rally Championship's top-class has run to Rally1 regulations, featuring spaceframe machines powered by 1.6-litre turbocharged engines – initially with hybrid powertrains.
Largely freed from the homologation rules of the World Rally Cars they replaced, Rally1 machines were just about the fastest thing to ever hit a rally stage.

This weekend's Rally Sardinia season finale will be the final outing for the Rally1 class, before the new WRC2027 machines – featuring less powerful engines and a spec tubular chassis – come into force.

items.title: I tried taking the budget-priced Ride1Up Roadster V3 e-bike off-roading. Here’s what happened next
items.summary: The Ride1Up Roadster V3 is, for all intents and purposes, is a budget-focused daily driver urban bike. It’s not really a gravel bike. Maybe if you stand back a bit and squint, you could give it a bit more of a gravel bike interpretation. But ultimately, it’s a lightweight, affordable urban e-bike with decent multi-role tires that I mostly use for cruising around bike lanes and city streets. So nat
facts: The Ride1Up Roadster V3 is, for all intents and purposes, is a budget-focused daily driver urban bike.
So naturally, yesterday I took it on a 38 km (24 mile) ride where I spent most of the time off-road.
The little $1,295 e-bike surprised me.
The ride started with a train trip north of the city, which immediately highlighted one of the Roadster V3’s biggest advantages: it’s light.

Compared to the 70- or 80-pound fat-tire e-bikes that have become increasingly common, getting the Roadster through the train station, onto the train, and even holding it securely on escalators in the stations was refreshingly easy.

items.title: FedEx believes $300M electric truck spend will save them $800M in diesel

facts: In a record-setting commercial truck deal, international shipping giant FedEx has placed an order for 2,000 all-electric box trucks from American startup Harbinger in a deal that’s reportedly worth more than $300 million – but the ROI could be much higher.

FedEx is making serious moves to fully electrify its operating fleet by 2040, and this latest Harbinger deal is believed to be one of the largest binding orders for electric medium or heavy-duty trucks in history.

Harbinger estimates that each of the electric Class 5 and 6 medium-duty box trucks delivered will reduce FedEx’ fuel costs by around $20,000 annually compared with the conventional diesel-powered vehicle they replace.

items.title: The world’s tallest wind turbine just reached 1,197 feet
items.summary: The world’s tallest wind turbine has reached its full height in Germany, and its developer says the extra altitude could roughly double its electricity output. more…
facts: GICON‘s pilot turbine in Schipkau, eastern Germany, stands 365 meters (1,197 feet) tall, including its blades.
Its rotor hub sits 300 meters (984 feet) above the ground.
The turbine has a rated capacity of 3.8 megawatts (MW), while future versions are planned to exceed 7 MW.
“365 meters – this is an overwhelming moment for our entire team,” said GICON founder and CEO Jochen Großmann.
Their current assessment suggests Germany’s existing wind farms could potentially accommodate up to 4,000 high-altitude turbines, adding generation without developing new wind farm areas.

According to a report in the Financial Times , the UK has been told by the EU that it must app
facts: Right now the UK charges only 10% on the landing price of Chinese EVs, which has helped to turbocharge the market for Chinese cars over the past two years.
The UK car market has been transformed by Chinese firms, which took a 23% share in September .
EVs and PHEVs such as September’s market leader, the Jaecoo 7 , have found willing customers looking for electrified models at affordable prices as fuel prices have soared.
The Japanese company's UK market share fell to 3.1% in September, down from 4.5% the same month the year before.
A similar charge was levelled against the Japanese when they used the UK as a springboard into Europe in the 1970s and 1980s.

Hallmark joined Aston Martin from Bentley in September 2024 and had previously sug
facts: Due to uncertain EV demand and changing legislation, the British firm will focus on ICE cars for the rest of the decade Aston Martin will not launch its first electric car until at least 2033, according to boss Adrian Hallmark, and has a “roadmap” to ensure it can offer cars with V8 and V12 engines until least 2035.

Hallmark joined Aston Martin from Bentley in September 2024 and had previously suggested the firm would launch its first EV by 2030 – which was already a pushback from the 2027 date set by previous management.
“We only need BEVs to be compliant for legislative reasons [in certain markets] just before 2035," said Hallmark.

facts: Tesla is now putting its larger 16-inch center touchscreen in every Model 3 sold in the US, Puerto Rico, and Mexico, a day after it rolled out the same upgrade in China.
The Model 3 Performance also gets a black headliner, 316 miles of range, and 528 hp, while the Premium AWD now does 0 to 60 mph in 3.8 seconds.

What’s new on the US Model 3
The 16-inch display replaces the 15.4-inch unit across the lineup, and that includes the base Model 3 RWD at $36,990.
Tesla’s comparison tool now lists a 16-inch first-row touchscreen for every trim.

items.title: Tesla launches capability to drive away while plugged in after deadly Supercharger shooting
items.summary: Tesla launched a new feature called “Emergency Drive Away” that lets drivers shift into Drive and leave while still plugged into a Supercharger. The update comes two months after a gunman shot three people in Teslas at a Supercharger station in Twin Falls, Idaho. And Tesla is limiting it to the US. more…
facts: The update comes two months after a gunman shot three people in Teslas at a Supercharger station in Twin Falls, Idaho.
Tesla’s charging team announced the feature on X today with a 36-second video and a few short follow-up posts:
The feature requires software update 2026.38.3, and Model S and Model X vehicles built before 2021 aren’t supported.
On August 1, a gunman killed three people and injured seven at an In-N-Out in Twin Falls, Idaho.
According to police, he fired on three people in two Teslas at the Supercharger station next to the restaurant, and one of them, a 66-year-old man from Salt Lake City, died.

items.title: California gives the green light to balcony solar
items.summary: Californians who can’t install rooftop solar are getting another way to tap into the sunshine. Governor Gavin Newsom signed a bill opening the door to small plug-in solar, also known as balcony solar, alongside two laws designed to get more out of home energy devices and the grid California already has. All three were signed on September 30. more…
facts: All three were signed on September 30.
For renters, apartment dwellers, and homeowners with unsuitable roofs, the most immediately relatable change is SB 868, state Senator Scott Wiener’s Plug and Play Solar Act.
Balcony solar is pretty much what it sounds like: small solar systems that can sit on a sunny balcony, patio, or backyard and plug into a 120v household outlet.
California’s law covers balcony solar systems with a combined output of up to 1,200 watts AC per household.
Those utility exemptions expire on January 1, 2030, under the signed legislation.

items.title: The Hyundai IONIQ 5 is still in the EV sales mix, with 31,000+ sold in 2026
items.summary: The Hyundai IONIQ 5 is still one of the EVs Americans are buying the most, with more than 31,000 sold through September. more…
facts: The Hyundai IONIQ 5 is still one of the EVs Americans are buying the most, with more than 31,000 sold through September.
Hyundai IONIQ 5 ranks among America’s top-selling EVs
After the $7,500 federal tax credit expired last September, most automakers reported fewer EV sales than a year ago as buyers rushed to claim the credit, Hyundai included.
Hyundai responded shortly after by reducing the price of the 2026 IONIQ 5 by up to $9,800 on some trims.
Hyundai sold 2,928 IONIQ 5s in the third quarter, down 65% from the more than 8,400 it moved in Q3 2025.
Through the first nine months of 2026, Hyundai sold 31,112 IONIQ 5s, 24% fewer than last year, when the $7,500 tax credit was still available.

items.title: Toyota bucks the trend as new EVs drive growth
items.summary: Toyota’s new electric vehicles are selling surprisingly well, even as many automakers report fewer EV sales in the third quarter. more…
facts: Toyota Motor North America, including Lexus, sold 633,233 vehicles in Q3 2026, up 0.6% from Q3 2025.
Although GM remained ahead, selling nearly 671,000 vehicles in the US last quarter, Toyota’s electrified vehicles helped close the gap.
GM blamed “the much smaller EV market and discontinued vehicles” after reporting that Q3 sales were down 6% from the third quarter of 2025.
Sales of GM’s most popular electric vehicle, the Chevy Equinox EV, plunged 92% to just 1,905 units sold.
That’s a stark contrast to the more than 25,000 GM moved in Q3 2025.
After introducing the updated bZ (formerly the bZ4X), Toyota’s electric SUV quickly became one of America’s most popular EVs.

items.title: Chevy Equinox EV sales plunge 92% as Cadillac’s SUVs suddenly take the lead
items.summary: The Chevy Equinox EV’s run as GM’s top-selling electric car is quickly coming to an end after sales dropped 92% in Q3. more…
facts: The Chevy Equinox EV’s run as GM’s top-selling electric car is quickly coming to an end after sales dropped 92% in Q3.
GM Q3 EV sales drop across the board
After reporting that Q3 sales fell by 6% with 670,974 vehicles sold in the US, GM blamed “the much smaller EV market and discontinued vehicles.”
Like many automakers, GM’s EV sales were much lower than last year after the Trump Administration ended the $7,500 federal tax credit last September.
Sales of nearly every GM electric vehicle were lower in the third quarter compared to Q3 2025, when the credit was still being offered.

items.title: BMW is launching a smaller, more affordable EV
items.summary: BMW joins the growing list of luxury brands planning to introduce an entry-level electric vehicle. The new model will be the most affordable Neue Klasse EV. more…
facts: BMW prepares a new entry-level EV for 2028
The new entry-level EV will arrive in 2028, “with a focus on Europe,” BMW said, using technologies introduced in other Neue Klasse models, such as the new iX3 SUV and i3 sedan.
The i1, as it’s expected to be called, will likely be sold alongside the gas-powered 1 Series.
BMW’s entry-level EV will sit between the MINI Cooper Electric and the iX1 or iX2 in its European lineup.
Cheaper i1 trims will likely be RWD, while higher-priced xDrive models are expected to offer AWD.
It would be a little weird for the i2 to be a sedan, it should be a coupe.
The i1 should be offered in sedan and hatchback formats, similar to the i3.

items.title: Ford’s $30,000 Fathom EV pickup production launch faces uncertainty [Update]
items.summary: The Ford Fathom is expected to go on sale in early 2027, starting at $28,350. Ford CEO Jim Farley admitted, “It’s going to be a heck of an effort to launch this at scale, at cost, on time.” more…
facts: The Ford Fathom is expected to go on sale in early 2027, starting at $28,350.
After Ford said just last month it was on track to begin Fathom production in 2027, that timeline is now facing uncertainty.

Speaking at the 2026 Automotive News Congress this week, Ford CEO Jim Farley explained how its Universal Electric Vehicle (UEV) platform could be the automaker’s answer to Chinese brands like BYD, which are rapidly gaining market share in Europe and other key global markets.
Farley said the company realized at one point that a BYD EV would have roughly a 20% cost advantage over Fathom’s battery.

facts: - GWM sold 114,944 vehicles in September, down 13.99% year-on-year, bringing sales for the first 9 months into decline at 0.33%.
- Domestic sales fell about 34% year-on-year, marking an eleventh consecutive month of contraction.
GWM (HKEX: 2333) sold 114,944 vehicles in September, down 13.99% year-on-year, despite a 1.37% increase from August.
The year-on-year decline was also its largest since January 2025, partly reflecting a high comparison base.
GWM sold 133,639 vehicles in September 2025, up 23.29% year-on-year.
GWM sold 920,302 vehicles in the first 9 months of this year, down 0.33% year-on-year.
Its cumulative sales were still up 1.98% at the end of August.

facts: - Geely Auto exported 106,685 vehicles in September, up 162% year-on-year but down 3% from August, ending 8 consecutive months of record exports.

Geely Auto (HKEX: 0175) posted its highest monthly sales of the year in September as its domestic decline eased, though exports, which have underpinned growth, fell sequentially for the first time this year.
The Chinese automaker sold 292,168 vehicles in September, up 6.97% year-on-year and 8.13% from August, according to data released Thursday.

facts: - Huawei and Seres are deepening their partnership about 2 weeks after announcing a shift in control of the Aito brand's operations.

Huawei and Seres (HKEX: 9927) have signed a new 5-year cooperation agreement to jointly upgrade the Aito business, deepening their partnership about 2 weeks after announcing a shift in control of the brand's operations.
The signing ceremony took place on September 30 in Shenzhen, where Huawei is headquartered.
Aito's user base has surpassed 1.2 million, according to the announcement.

items.title: BYD September sales rise 16.98% to 463,561, hitting new high for 2026
items.summary: BYD posted its fifth consecutive month of year-on-year NEV sales growth and seventh consecutive month of sequential growth. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - Passenger BEV sales hit a record 273,143, with cumulative sales for the first 9 months returning to year-on-year growth.
BYD (HKEX: 1211) sold 463,561 new energy vehicles (NEVs) in September, up 16.98% year-on-year and its highest monthly total this year, extending a recovery from a weak start to 2026.
Sales rose 5.28% from August, its seventh consecutive monthly increase.
BYD sold 1,323,065 NEVs in the third quarter, up 18.75% year-on-year and 19.41% from the second quarter, according to data compiled by CnEVPost.
This marked the company's return to quarterly year-on-year sales growth after 4 consecutive quarters of declines.

items.title: Huawei HIMA delivers 37,490 vehicles in September, extending year-on-year decline to fourth month
items.summary: HIMA's September deliveries fell 29.15% year-on-year, with year-to-date growth slowing to 5.27%. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - HIMA's September deliveries fell 29.15% year-on-year, with year-to-date growth slowing to 5.27%.
- Deliveries declined 10.95% from August, marking the alliance's third consecutive month-on-month decrease.
Huawei-led Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance (HIMA) delivered 37,490 vehicles in September, its fourth consecutive month of year-on-year declines, signaling mounting sales pressure.
September deliveries fell 29.15% from a year earlier and 10.95% from August, according to figures HIMA released on Thursday.
In the first 9 months of the year, HIMA delivered 367,229 vehicles, up 5.27% from a year earlier.
That marked a sharp slowdown from the 11.42% growth recorded in the first 8 months.

items.title: Zeekr delivers 37,216 vehicles in September, its sixth straight monthly record

facts: - Zeekr's September deliveries rose 103.85% year-on-year, extending its streak of both annual and monthly growth to 8 consecutive months.
- The flagship 9X hybrid SUV delivered 7,225 vehicles in September as production of the 5-seat version ramped up and deliveries accelerated.
Zeekr, the premium brand under Geely Auto (HKEX: 0175), delivered 37,216 vehicles in September, up 103.85% year-on-year and 0.64% from August, according to figures released Thursday.
Zeekr has posted both year-on-year and month-on-month growth for 8 consecutive months.
September's performance brought its deliveries so far this year to 288,404 vehicles, up 100.84% from a year earlier.

items.title: Xpeng September deliveries hit 2026 high despite slight year-on-year decline

Xpeng (NYSE: XPEV) delivered 41,256 vehicles in September, lifting deliveries for the third quarter to a record and meeting its previously issued quarterly guidance.

The deliveries were the highest for any month this year but slightly below the 41,581 vehicles delivered a year earlier, ending 3 consecutive months of year-on-year growth from June through August.

items.title: Tesla gives Model 3 minor upgrades in China, keeps prices unchanged

facts: - All Model 3 variants currently on sale get a 16-inch central touchscreen, up from 15.4 inches, and a new optional light gray premium interior.

Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) has given the Model 3 minor feature upgrades in China, adding a larger central touchscreen and a new interior option while keeping prices unchanged.

The company said the new screen offers higher resolution and a higher refresh rate for navigation, entertainment and gaming.
